name: campaign-kit-maps
label: Campaign Kit Maps
description: Two random maps built for naval play. Halcyon is a golden-hour archipelago where every nation gets its own island and the stone and metal sit on contested mid-sea islets. The Narrows splits the map with a navigable strait: hold it and you win, and the mainland is deliberately short of metal so you have to. Halcyon has three biomes — Golden Hour, Squall and Moonlight.
